Class MoveEdit

java.lang.Object
edits.Edit
edits.MoveEdit
public class MoveEdit extends Edit
Represents an undo-able move operation on a MyShape within a ShapeCanvas.

This class extends the abstract Edit base class and provides functionality to undo and redo the movement of a shape. When an instance of MoveEdit is created, it stores a reference to the shape being moved, the canvas it belongs to, and the displacement applied to the shape. The displacement is represented by the horizontal and vertical offsets (dx and dy), which are applied during redo and reversed during undo.
